precondition: Test build of frontend + backend; Chair, Secretary, Member and Administrator accounts supplied by QA lead; meetings in the needed status with recordings, transcripts, sentences and Voice ID consent as each case says; the speech worker and the AI server running (QA lead can stop them); microphone permission in the browser for recording cases; Chrome and a second browser for the two-user cases.

cases.description: Verify the Secretary opens a recording and reads the transcript with speakers and times.
procedure: Open the meeting from "/mgmt/meetings" and click the tab "Bản ghi".
Click "Nghe và xem bản gỡ băng" on the recording row.
expected: The recording row shows the chip "Có bản gỡ băng"; the transcript lists lines grouped by speaker under a heading "Người nói" with the count of voices.
The note reads "Máy nhận dạng" and "Chữ do máy tạo, có thể sai — bấm vào mốc giờ để nghe lại đoạn đó."
Each run of lines shows a time, the speaker name (or "Người nói N" for an unnamed voice) and the text; the backend answered GET /api/recordings/{recordingId}/transcript with 200.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Secretary on the "Bản ghi" tab of a meeting whose recording has a Completed transcript with two voices.

cases.description: Verify clicking a time plays the audio from that moment and highlights the line being heard.

Clicking "Tạm dừng" pauses it.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Secretary on the "Bản ghi" tab of a meeting whose recording has a Completed transcript with two voices.

"Giữ lại" changes nothing; "Tắt và xoá" shows "Đã tắt nhận diện giọng nói và xoá toàn bộ giọng mẫu." (200/MSG306) and the page returns to the consent card with no samples; turning it on again restores none.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a user with Voice ID on, own samples and a Secretary-recorded sample.
cases.note: UC-81f | Law 91/2025/QH15 | Manual UI check | Automated: tests/TrustCabinet.Web.Tests/Recordings/VoiceIdEndpointTests.cs (Withdrawing_erases_samples_and_suggestions_but_keeps_what_the_secretary_decided; Withdrawing_erases_both_sets_at_once)

cases.description: Verify the tab "Thư ký thu hộ" lists what Secretaries recorded and lets the person hear and delete it.
procedure: Open "/mgmt/my-voice?tab=proxy" (or click the notification "Thư ký đã thu giọng mẫu của bạn").
expected: The tab "Thư ký thu hộ" shows each sample with the meeting title as a link, "<Secretary> · <date>" (tooltip with length and time) and buttons "Nghe lại mẫu thu hộ 1" and "Xoá mẫu thu hộ 1"; deleting asks "Xoá mẫu thu hộ?" — "Mẫu này bị xoá hẳn, không lấy lại được."
With no sample: "Chưa có mẫu nào. Thư ký thu ở cuộc họp trực tiếp hoặc kết hợp bạn dự."; without the new notice: "Đồng ý điều khoản mới ở trên để Thư ký cuộc họp thu giọng mẫu hộ bạn."
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant whose Secretary recorded a sample.

cases.description: Verify a person on an older notice is asked to agree again before anything new applies.
procedure: Open "/mgmt/my-voice" and click "Xem và đồng ý" in the notice "Điều khoản Voice ID đã thay đổi."
expected: The dialog "Điều khoản Voice ID mới" lists what changed (for example "Thư ký cuộc họp bạn dự thu được giọng mẫu hộ bằng micro phòng họp.") and "Chưa đồng ý thì mọi thứ giữ như cũ."
"Đồng ý điều khoản mới" renews the consent (200/MSG305) keeping the samples; "Để sau" changes nothing.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a user whose consent is to notice 1.2.

cases.description: Verify a notice changed while the page was open is refused with a reload hint.
procedure: Open the consent card, tick the box, and (QA lead) raise the server's notice version before clicking "Đồng ý và bật".
expected: The card shows "Nội dung thông báo đã thay đổi. Hãy tải lại trang và đọc lại trước khi đồng ý." (400/MSG313) and no consent is recorded.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a user without consent; QA lead can change the notice version.

cases.description: Verify the page is for the signed-in person only and needs a session.
procedure: Open "/mgmt/my-voice" while signed out.
expected: The app redirects to the login page; after sign-in only the signed-in person's own Voice ID is shown and no screen offers to enable it for someone else.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Not signed in; a second user with Voice ID on.

cases.description: Verify the Secretary with the capability sees the panel on the "Bản ghi" tab of an in-person or hybrid meeting.
procedure: Open the meeting from "/mgmt/meetings" and click the tab "Bản ghi".
expected: The card "Giọng mẫu cho mic phòng" lists each active participant with a "<n>/5" count when they have consented or the word "Chưa đồng ý" (tooltip "Người này chưa bật Voice ID, hoặc chưa đồng ý điều khoản mới, ở trang Giọng nói của tôi") and a "Thu" button only for those who can be recorded.
The info tip explains that only people who turned Voice ID on themselves can be recorded.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Secretary holding "Thu giọng mẫu hộ" on a Published or InProgress hybrid meeting with one consenting and one non-consenting participant.

cases.description: Verify the panel is hidden from everyone but the meeting's Secretary and for online or Secret meetings.
procedure: Open the "Bản ghi" tab as the Chair, as a Secretary whose role lacks "Thu giọng mẫu hộ", and as the Secretary of an Online meeting and of a Secret meeting.
expected: No card "Giọng mẫu cho mic phòng" appears in any of these; a direct request answers 403 (no capability) or 404 (not this meeting's Secretary, no room mic, Secret).
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Chair of a hybrid meeting; a Secretary without the capability; Secretaries of an Online meeting and a Secret meeting.

cases.description: Verify the Secretary records a participant on the room's mic.
procedure: On the "Bản ghi" tab click "Thu" beside a consenting participant.
Click "Bắt đầu ghi", let them read the passage for at least 8 seconds, click "Dừng", listen, and click "Lưu giọng mẫu".
expected: The dialog is titled "Thu giọng mẫu: <name>" with the hint "Dùng micro phòng họp. Mời người này ngồi chỗ quen thuộc, nói tự nhiên như khi phát biểu, đọc đoạn văn sau:".
A toast shows "Đã lưu giọng mẫu thu hộ." (201/MSG473); the person's list shows "Mẫu 1" with length and date and the count rises.
The participant (second browser) receives a notification "Thư ký đã thu giọng mẫu của bạn" and sees the sample on the tab "Thư ký thu hộ" of "/mgmt/my-voice".
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.

Signed in as the Secretary holding "Thu giọng mẫu hộ" on a Published or InProgress hybrid meeting; a consenting participant in a second browser; microphone permission granted; the speech worker running.

cases.description: Verify the Secretary hears and deletes a sample taken in this meeting.
procedure: Click "Nghe lại mẫu 1 của <name>".
Click "Xoá mẫu 1 của <name>" and confirm.
expected: Step 1: the sample plays and the button turns to "Dừng".
Step 2: a dialog "Xoá mẫu thu hộ?" says "Mẫu này của <name> bị xoá hẳn. Muốn thay thì thu lại mẫu mới."; "Xoá" shows "Đã xoá giọng mẫu thu hộ." (200/MSG474) and the count falls; the play is audited.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Secretary on a meeting where a sample was recorded.
cases.note: UC-81d | UC-86 | Manual UI check | Automated: tests/TrustCabinet.Web.Tests/Recordings/VoiceCollectionEndpointTests.cs (The_secretary_hears_and_deletes_only_samples_taken_in_their_meeting_and_each_play_is_audited)

cases.description: Verify "Thu" is not offered at the limit or after the meeting is over.
procedure: Look at a participant with 5 Secretary samples, then at the same panel of an Ended meeting.
expected: No "Thu" button beside the person with "5/5"; for an Ended meeting the notice reads "Chỉ thu thêm được khi cuộc họp đã công bố hoặc đang họp." and no "Thu" button appears (409/MSG476 and 409/MSG477 on direct calls).
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Secretary; a participant with 5 Secretary samples; an Ended hybrid meeting.

cases.description: Verify a participant who withdrew meanwhile cannot be recorded and the dialog says why.
procedure: Open "Thu" for a participant, and while the dialog is open the participant turns Voice ID off in a second browser; then click "Lưu giọng mẫu".
expected: The dialog shows "Người này chưa đồng ý dùng Voice ID theo điều khoản mới. Họ bật ở trang Giọng nói của tôi." (409/MSG475), the list refreshes and the participant now reads "Chưa đồng ý"; nothing is stored.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Secretary; a consenting participant in a second browser.

cases.description: Verify a rejected take shows the reason in the dialog.
procedure: Record a take that is too short or too quiet for a participant and click "Lưu giọng mẫu".
expected: The dialog shows the message of the reason (for example "Giọng mẫu quá ngắn — cần ít nhất 6 giây có tiếng nói. Hãy đọc hết đoạn văn mẫu.", 422/MSG309) and stays open for "Ghi lại".
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Secretary; a consenting participant; microphone permission granted.

cases.description: Verify the Administrator opens "Cấu hình AI" and sees what is in use.
procedure: Click "Cấu hình AI" in the sidebar ("/mgmt/admin/ai").
